note: Jacquet de La Guerre: Brossard MS title says 'viola di gamba obligata con organo' (La Rêveuse), but The Bach Players treat the two A-minor sonatas as violin and continuo; own-line follows the MS title. Finger Nos. 4-6 and Kreusser Op. 10 are inferences (separate bass part-books beside the continuo, no score seen); Fioré, Furchheim, Kirchhoff, Graupner, Guerrieri folded as unclear/continuo-type bass. Gibbons: the organ doubles the bass viol, so the viol is kept.
